payload.claim: The docstring says it refuses when the outcome's own row, or another row at READY_FOR_REVIEW/CHANGES_REQUESTED/APPROVED/REBUTTAL_UNJUDGED/EXHAUSTED, 'already carries a pull request' — but the code at lines 1203-1211 refuses on another row at READY_FOR_REVIEW unconditionally, with no pr_url check at all. The docstring misstates READY_FOR_REVIEW's refusal as conditioned on carrying a pull request, when it is not.
